gen_seek_main: run the script to generate a seek map JSON file from a JSONL input file
gen_seek_get_args: run argparse to parse one or more JSONL source file paths as command line arguments
gen_seek_seek_map: build a list of byte offset positions for each line in a JSONL file
gen_seek_output: write a JSON array of seek positions to a .seek.map file alongside the source
gen_seek_tqdm_progress: display a progress bar while reading lines from a JSONL file with smoothing disabled
